rows.ja: どっちか諦めるしかない
rows.line: どっちか諦めるしかないよね。
rows.en1: You've got to give up one or the other.

rows.line: そこまで本当に全部振り切ってできるかっていうとね。
rows.en1: But can you really go all in? That's the thing.
rows.en2: Whether you'd actually commit all the way, though...

rows.line: 僕みたいな失うものも何もないようなタイプ。
rows.en1: I had nothing to lose.

rows.line: 挑戦するのにちょっと恐怖心じゃないけど。
rows.en1: Not fear exactly, but...
rows.en2: I wouldn't call it fear, but...

rows.line: 収入入ってこなくなったらどうしようみたいな。
rows.en1: Like, what if the money stops coming in?
rows.en2: That 'what am I going to do if...' feeling.

rows.line: 不安っていうのはあんまり言ってられないのが現実。
rows.en1: You can't afford to worry about that.

rows.line: どうしようみたいなことを考える暇があったら。
rows.en1: If I've got time to stress about that, I'd rather...
rows.en2: Instead of worrying about it, I'm thinking about...

rows.line: ネガティブなことを考えても意味がないというか。
rows.en1: There's no point, really.

rows.line: ネガティブが突き動かしてくれる時もあんやけど、付き合い方よね。
rows.en1: It's all about how you handle it.
rows.en2: It's how you deal with it.

rows.line: もうそんなもんは起きてから考えろよって。
rows.en1: Cross that bridge when you get to it.
rows.en2: Worry about it when it happens.

rows.line: 絶対思い通りに行くなんてことはなくって。
rows.en1: Things never go exactly how you plan.

rows.ja: 最初からそのつもりで
rows.line: 最初からそのつもりで取り組んでるし。
rows.en1: I go in expecting that.
rows.en2: That's the plan from day one.

rows.line: 時代に、潮を読む、風を読む。
rows.en1: See which way the wind's blowing.

rows.line: 思ってれば思ってるほどきついと思う。
rows.en1: The more you think that way, the harder it gets.
rows.en2: The tighter you hold on, the worse it is.

rows.line: 変な先入観みたいなのをとっぱらって考えられたら。
rows.en1: Just drop all the assumptions.
rows.en2: Clear your head of all that.

rows.line: 僕はなんでかって言うと、具体的な目線で見てないから。
rows.en1: And here's why.

rows.line: その人の価値観がもう浮き彫りになる。そう、丸見えや。
rows.en1: It's written all over their face.
rows.en2: You can see right through it.

rows.line: 相手にそれを言うて、よく言えるなって感じやな。
rows.en1: How can you even say that?

rows.ja: 別にそれいいんやけども
rows.line: まぁ別にそれいいんやけども。
rows.en1: Not that I care, but...

rows.line: 本業以外でお金儲けちゃあかんなみたいな感じ。
rows.en1: Like you're not allowed to make money on the side.
rows.en2: Like it's wrong to earn outside your main gig.

rows.line: でもどっちかというと長い目で見るというか。
rows.en1: If anything...

rows.line: どっちかというと長い目で見るというか。
rows.en1: Think long-term.

rows.line: こうやってこう深掘りしていくんや。
rows.en1: You just keep digging.

rows.line: その思わぬトラブルっていうものが起きた時。
rows.en1: Stuff you don't see coming.

rows.line: 本来そっちの方が合理的やん。ほんまやな。
rows.en1: True that.

rows.ja: 矛盾してんのに気づいた
rows.line: めっちゃ自分も今矛盾してんのに気づいたわ。
rows.en1: Wow, I just caught myself contradicting myself.

rows.ja: 自分の都合のいいように
rows.line: 自分の都合のいいように変えてるっていうのは。
rows.en1: Twisting it to suit yourself.

rows.line: 自分を知らず知らずと刷り込まれてる。
rows.en1: Without even realizing it.
rows.en2: It just sneaks up on you.

rows.line: 節約っていうよりかは貯金とかそっちになってくる。
rows.en1: Less saving money on stuff, more putting it away.
rows.en2: It's not so much cutting back as stashing it.

rows.line: どんな人でも自力で本気出せば稼げると思う。
rows.en1: If you really put your mind to it.
rows.en2: If you actually go for it.

rows.line: そうね、頑張るしかないからな。
rows.en1: You just have to push through.
rows.en2: Nothing to do but keep going.

rows.line: そうもうそれしかないもんね。
rows.en1: That's all you can do.

rows.line: 意外とこれ全然違うとこに行っちゃうのよね、元を辿ればね。
rows.en1: When you trace it all back...
rows.en2: If you go back to the root of it...

rows.line: 個別セッションで30分無料相談、今ならなんと。
rows.en1: And for a limited time only...
